ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 0.65:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe exhibits a large contiguous high-intensity region with low-intensity peripheral mottling; right lobe is predominantly low-intensity with scattered high-intensity focal spots located in the lower-mid quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes extending from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several vertical, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the high-intensity surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Reddish-brown pixel clusters (biological fouling or tissue trauma) present at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; irregular jagged notch on the distal third of the right lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-contrast reddish-brown biological material or lesions at both fluke tips, distinct from standard pigmentation.
